transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Doctor. Thank you so much for fitting me in. I, um... I hope I'm not taking up time from someone who needs it more. 

Well, I suppose I'm here because of a... a rather difficult situation at my apartment building. I know tenant disputes probably aren't what you usually deal with, but it's been going on for months now. The property manager and, well, certain people in the building have been trying to pressure me out of my apartment. 

I try not to make a fuss, really, I'm usually very quiet, but it's become quite a clear pattern. It started with constantly misdelivered mail, and then... well, these very specific, timed noises in the walls, right when I'm trying to rest. And little comments from the neighbors that are just... a bit too pointed to be accidental. 

I'm a management analyst, so my whole graduate background is in looking at data objectively, and... well, I know how it might sound to an outsider, but no amount of their paperwork or polite explanations changes the pattern I can clearly see happening. It’s just been incredibly stressful to manage, and I thought maybe talking to someone would be the responsible thing to do. Does that... does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining it properly.
Aside from the noises in the walls, have you ever heard voices or sounds when there was no one around to make them?

Oh, goodness no. No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I mean, I know that's something people can struggle with, and I have the utmost sympathy for them, but... no, not me. 

The noises I'm talking about are very real. They're physical sounds, like pipes clanking or tapping, just... timed very deliberately. But voices? No, never. I assure you, my mind is quite sound. I wouldn't want you to think I'm losing my grip on reality or anything like that. I'm just a normal person dealing with a very... coordinated harassment campaign. 

I hope that's clear? I really don't want to give you the wrong impression. I'm just trying to be as accurate as possible for you.
Have you ever felt that an outside force or person was able to read, control, or interfere with your thoughts?

Oh, goodness, no. No, absolutely not. My thoughts are entirely my own. I... I completely understand why you have to ask these sorts of questions to be thorough, and I'm more than happy to answer them, but no, nothing like that. 

I've never felt anyone was interfering with my mind or reading my thoughts. That sounds... well, that sounds very frightening, and I truly feel for anyone who has to go through that, but it's just not something I've ever experienced. My mind is quite clear. Like I said, my background is in analysis, so I rely very heavily on my own faculties being sharp! 

I'm really just dealing with a very physical, real-world issue with the people in my building. I hope I'm not giving you the impression that I'm... well, that I'm unwell in that way. I'm just trying to be as cooperative and transparent as possible. Am I giving you the information you need? I want to make sure I'm being helpful.
Outside of your apartment building, have you ever felt that coworkers or people in your personal life were working against you?

Oh, no, definitely not. My colleagues are... well, they're wonderful, really. We have a very professional, collaborative relationship. And my friends and family, no, nothing like that at all. 

I... I really don't want you to think I'm the sort of person who goes around suspecting everyone of things. I'm actually quite agreeable, I promise! It's truly just this one, isolated issue with the property management, simply because the pattern is right there in front of me and I can't ignore it. But outside of the building? No, my life is very normal and pleasant. 

Does that... does that help put your mind at ease about how I'm viewing things? I really want to make sure I'm giving you the right picture and being a good patient for you.
